title: MeetingCost: see what your meetings really cost
description: Add attendees with hourly rates, start the timer, and watch the real cost tick up live.

body.text: Meetings feel free. They are not. MeetingCost puts the real number on screen while the meeting is happening.
Add each attendee with their hourly rate. Start the timer. A big ticker shows the running cost, updating every second, with a per-person breakdown underneath.
A visible cost changes behavior. Agendas get tighter. Invite lists get shorter. Meetings end on time.

items: Client calls with five people on them
Add attendees and set hourly rates (presets included)
Enter minutes manually or start the live timer
Watch the ticker — pause or reset anytime

body.text: MeetingCost is $8 a month, or $40 for six months. Pay the admin, request your unlock PIN, and the tool opens up for your whole subscription.
